rows.label: US dollars per pound sterling, 2019 annual average

source.title: Bank of England, Statistical Interactive Database, series XUAAUSS (annual average spot exchange rate, US$ into sterling)

rows.explainer: The average of the Bank of England's daily spot rates over 2019. Models that import a cost stated in pounds for a year's spending convert it to dollars at that year's average, so every model on the site counts per dollar.
